subject.title: feat(android): syntax-highlighted code blocks in chat

question: Should this PR be allowed to merge with a manual CHANGELOG.md entry despite the root release-owned changelog policy?
rationale: The policy is clear, but the PR discussion includes an explicit disagreement and the PR has a protected maintainer label, so the final exception decision belongs to a human maintainer.

options.title: Remove before merge
options.body: Drop the CHANGELOG.md entry and let release generation derive the final note from the merged PR metadata.

options.title: Accept the exception
options.body: Merge with the manual changelog entry and have maintainers own any duplicate or stale release-note cleanup during release generation.

recommendation.title: Remove before merge
recommendation.body: Drop the CHANGELOG.md entry and let release generation derive the final note from the merged PR metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current branch and the discussion that disputed the changelog finding, making him the clearest person to resolve the policy exception before merge.
